tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma la mchod gtor phrin bcol bcas shlau ka lnga// na mo gu ru bhya/ gsung ngag dbang bzhi'i smin grol kun dga'i gter/ /blo gros zab mo'i sangs rgyas bstan pa'i bdag /rgyal ba'i go 'phang ngo mtshar mtshan gyi dpal/ /bzang po'i 'byung gnas dpal ldan bla mar 'dud/ /stong nyid snying rje zung 'jug he badzra/ /srid dang zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol ba'i lha/ /brtan g.yo'i bdag nyid gzugs sku'i snang brnyan du/ /bdag nyid skad cig yid kyis gsal bar gyur/ /bde stong rang bzhin bandha'i snod yangs par/ /lcags kyu sgron ma ye shes lnga dag bcud/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod sprin gtams/ /ma hā kā la ral gcig 'dod khams ma/ /gnod sbyin yab yum pu tra bha ṭa sring / /seng gzig dom dred gdong ma bzhi la sogs/ /rgyud gsum dregs tshogs mnyes shing nyes kun bshags/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin dar zhing 'jig rten bde/ /zhi rgyas dbang drag las kyis phrin gsol bzhin/ /bdag gi gnas skabs don kun 'grub pa dang / ring por mi thogs 'gro rnams sangs rgyas shog /oṃ dāe wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ ma hā kā la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ e ka dza ṭi de wi ind+ra si hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kā li dāe wi hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā la yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra kā li yakṣa si hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra yakṣa pu tra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ru tra bha ṭa ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badzra ru lu rakkha si hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sidha mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ārya mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rakṣ-i sa mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ rakṣa sa mu kha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces nged rang la bstod pa/ kyai rdo rje'i mngon rtogs gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma la mchod gtor phrin bcol bcas shlau ka lnga tsam zhig la 'thus pa dang / yi dam chos skyong de dag gi sngags bcas dgos zhes sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros la ir ti ne jo ba'i dge bskos chen po dge slong blo bzang chos grub ces dar han bi lig thu nas rten bcas bskul ngor de 'phral sbyar//
